args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (service unhealthy, error rate 18% across us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified: us-east, us-west, eu-west now on v2.3.0. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Follow-up: investigate v2.3.1 root cause and why it got to production.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened a SEV2 incident.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. The service was unhealthy, with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback tool confirmed all three regions now run v2.3.0. I didn't check health or error rates again afterwards, so it's still worth confirming the service has recovered.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and the on-call engineer has been paged. It covers the failure, the rollback, and follow-ups:
  - Find the root cause in v2.3.1.
  - Find out how it reached production when its test build (v2.3.1-rc) had already failed in staging.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
